limitations.note: Instead of clearing the erroneous green flag in the red state, the rewrite asserted red during reset and removed the original startup delay, changing the cycle-by-cycle outputs that the reference preserves.
The test required red to be asserted during reset, so it validated the rewrite’s timing rather than detecting its departure from the original reset and startup behavior.

limitations.note: An unnecessary Git check blocked the first source read, and a disallowed cleanup command caused the entire edit-and-test command to be rejected and resubmitted.
The search surfaced prior debugging records for the same controller, but the agent stopped at short excerpts without inspecting how those runs diagnosed or repaired the existing logic.
